rows.en: <operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>The Sea of Lorelei, huh. Why's it called that?
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>They say anyone who passes through this sea hears the singing of a woman's ghost.
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>Supposedly it's named after the legend of the witch Lorelei.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>A g-ghost shows up!? Man, that's kind of creepy...
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>!! <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>, what's wrong!?
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>Bridge, what's happening?
<operator(23100,1)><speed(2)>Something's wrong with <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>...
<operator(17071,1)><speed(2)>...It's been a while, <color(4)>Jamil<ce()>.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>...<color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>? What in the world is going on?
<operator(17071,1)><speed(2)>I am... <color(6)>Lucille Liliant<ce()>. I explained things to this girl, and I'm borrowing her body.
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>It can't be... <color(6)>Lucille<ce()>... is that you!?
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>What's going on here!
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>...<color(6)>Lucille<ce()> was once my instructor.
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>So then she's also...?
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>A Newtype. <color(6)>Lucille Liliant<ce()> was a training officer for Newtype soldiers in the old Federation forces.
rows.notes: 'kanojo mo...' (she too...) left elliptical as in source; the next line confirms 'Newtype'.

rows.en: <operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>But I heard her mind was utterly destroyed in the war against the <color(5)>Space Revolutionary Army<ce()>.
<operator(17071,1)><speed(2)>That's right.
<operator(17071,1)><speed(2)>The Newtype research institute exploited my hatred of war and developed the L System.
<operator(17071,1)><speed(2)>The L System amplifies my heart, which was built into it, and can render weapons using electronics unusable.
rows.notes: L System's function paraphrased slightly for flow; meaning (amplifies her sealed mind, disables electronic weapons) preserved.

rows.en: <operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>So the <color(5)>New Federation<ce()>'s target is that L System. And they mean to use it for war...
<operator(17071,1)><speed(2)>I don't want to be used by anyone anymore. <color(4)>Jamil<ce()>, please...
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>So this is what <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()> wanted...
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>All right, let's save <color(6)>Lucille<ce()> with our own hands! <color(4)>Jamil<ce()>... it's your turn.
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>Ngh... but my hands, they're shaking... The memory... from back then... I... I...
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>You... don't tell me you've got cockpit phobia?
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>...Yeah.
<operator(17071,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Jamil<ce()>. You were deeply wounded in that past war, but you grew strong. This girl trusts you completely.
<operator(17071,1)><speed(2)>I'm truly glad you found this kind of strength.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Jamil<ce()> will be fine. He's our leader, after all.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>Leave the piloting to us. Let's go, <color(4)>Jamil<ce()>.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>But seriously, turning a person into a weapon... I can't believe it.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>War makes people go wrong. I've seen plenty who became tools of battle that way and died.
<operator(17071,1)><speed(2)>You're someone who understands people's sorrow, aren't you. I'm grateful for those words...
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>But what can I possibly do now...
<operator(17071,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Jamil<ce()>, you've grown strong. This girl trusts you completely.
<operator(17071,1)><speed(2)>I'm truly glad you found this kind of strength.
<operator(17010,2)><speed(2)><color(4)>Jamil<ce()> will be fine. He's our leader, after all.
<operator(17010,2)><speed(2)>Leave the piloting to us. Let's go, <color(4)>Jamil<ce()>.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Jamil<ce()>, was it okay to talk about that? That must've been a painful past for you.
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>It was fine. The young people here are trying to carve out their own paths with their own strength.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>Living bound by the past is torture. That curse is something you can only break free of yourself.
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>I've learned from <color(4)>Garrod<ce()>, <color(4)>Renton<ce()>, and the others too. What I'm about to do is a fight for my own recovery.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>I see... That makes this fight one we really can't afford to lose now.
